name: Sovryn Dollar
oneLiner: DLLR is Sovryn's BTC-backed dollar stablecoin on Rootstock, minted 1:1 via the Mynt aggregator from a basket of underlying CDP stables (mostly ZUSD).
collateral: Basket of BTC-backed Rootstock stablecoins, currently dominated by Sovryn Zero ZUSD with a small Dollar on Chain balance
pegMechanism: Mynt mints and redeems DLLR 1:1 against accepted bAssets; current supported bAssets include ZUSD and DOC

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified DLLR source exposes no blacklist, freeze, or pause function, but it has manager-gated burn(address,uint256) and an owner-settable MassetManager proxy. Treat as possible holder-balance intervention risk rather than confirmed direct blacklist.

mintAuthority.summary: DLLR is minted 1:1 by the Mynt MassetManager aggregator when users deposit accepted BTC-backed CDP stablecoins (ZUSD from Sovryn Zero, DOC from Money On Chain) as bAssets; it is an aggregator over already-overcollateralized stables, governed by Sovryn DAO which sets the accepted bAsset basket.

controls.label: Mynt MassetManager (1:1 aggregator mint)
controls.capDescription: Mints DLLR 1:1 only against deposited accepted bAssets (ZUSD, DOC); supply is bounded by deposited underlying stablecoins, not a fresh CDP.
controls.evidence: Mynt's MassetManager mints/redeems DLLR 1:1 against accepted bAssets; the underlying ZUSD and DOC are themselves BTC-overcollateralized CDP stables.

controls.label: Sovryn DAO (basket governance)
controls.evidence: Sovryn DAO governs the Mynt BasketManager (accepted bAssets and weights); adding a new bAsset effectively authorizes a new backing/mint route, a bounded governance surface.

review.evidence: Mynt (BabelFish-based) is a BTC-backed stablecoin aggregator, not a direct CDP: DLLR is the mAsset minted 1:1 from bAssets (ZUSD, DOC) via MassetManager 0x5f7772..., with Sovryn DAO governing the basket. Corrected framing from generic CDP to aggregator over user-collateralized stables.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Aggregator mint model and MassetManager address confirmed from Sovryn/Mynt materials; on-chain BasketManager admin/owner and DAO execution path not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the on-chain Mynt BasketManager admin owner and Sovryn DAO authorization path for adding bAssets.
